verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation product, but the evidence pack has nothing showing Amplitude Experiment can be self-hosted or deployed on-premises. The cited material covers only SaaS features (flags, experiments, the visual editor, SDKs and management APIs) plus agent-readable docs and an MCP server, none of which concern self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
